messages:
ana: Heads-up I'm landing a small docs PR for the private install notes: adding an SSH-tunnel example for customers that can't open KMS ports directly, plus checksum verification and a short HSM vendor caveat. github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1589 :wave:
frank: thanks. can you paste the ssh tunnel example here? good to keep it simple for SEs to copy-paste.
jules: also add the systemd unit for the tunnel so it persists across reboots. some customers forget that.
nana: (meant ana) pasted below — SSH tunnel that forwards local 8443 -> remote kms:8443 over a bastion: `ssh -L 127.0.0.1:8443:kms.internal:8443 bastion-user@bastion.example.com -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes`
frank: perfect. systemd unit (minimal) suggestion:
```ini
[Unit]
Description=SSH tunnel for KMS
After=network.target

[Service]
User=ops
ExecStart=/usr/bin/ssh -L 127.0.0.1:8443:kms.internal:8443 bastion-user@bastion.example.com -N -o ExitOnForwardFailure=yes
Restart=on-failure

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
```
jules: small nit: include `-o ServerAliveInterval=60` to avoid stale sessions. Also add `BindAddress=127.0.0.1` note for security.
nana: added that flag and updated PR. also included a tiny haproxy tcp proxy example for distros that prefer not to use SSH: `frontend local_kms bind 127.0.0.1:8443 mode tcp default_backend kms_backend` and backend pointing at `kms.internal:8443`
frank: for airgapped transfer, can you add the exact SHA256 verify command? SEs paste wrong flags sometimes.
jules: use this exact sequence in docs: `curl -fSLO https://mirror.redwood.internal/release-2026-05/images.tar.gz && curl -fSLO https://mirror.redwood.internal/release-2026-05/images.tar.gz.sha256 && sha256sum -c images.tar.gz.sha256` and fallback: `scp mirror:/tmp/images.tar.gz /tmp/ && sha256sum -c /tmp/images.tar.gz.sha256`
nana: added both. also pasted an openssl check for SNI issues: `openssl s_client -connect 127.0.0.1:8443 -servername kms.internal -showcerts` and a short note: "use -servername when proxying to ensure vendor HSM plugins that rely on SNI will work."
frank: good call. include a PKCS#11 probe example for customers to list tokens: `pkcs11-tool --module /usr/lib/*pkcs11* -L || pkcs11-tool --module /usr/local/lib/*pkcs11* -L`
jules: vendor caveat: mention that some HSM packages install under /opt/vendor/<name>/lib and that path searching is necessary. maybe add a one-liner: `find / -type f -name '*pkcs11*.so' 2>/dev/null | head -n 10`
nana: added the vendor note and the find one-liner. also changed wording from "expose certs" to: "KMS must present a certificate chain signed by the customer's root CA; private key material must remain on the HSM or be restricted to the KMS host." small wording change requested by legal.
ops-bot: PR 1589: label set to docs-review. 2 reviewers requested: @frank, @jules.
frank: will review tonight. focusing on SSH/proxy and the checksum sections.
jules: will check HSM wording and the PKCS#11 snippet.
nana: thanks all. plan to merge after green CI and then backport a 1-line pointer into the migration checklist for SEs. leaving a TODO to add a tiny script that validates SSH tunnel up/down and validates TLS chain via openssl (follow-up PR).
